findings.location: src/fleet_graph/selfgate.py; src/fleet_graph/decision_mcp.py; src/fleet_graph/graphs/goal_line.py (no self-gate orchestration node)
findings.summary: The six evidence obligations are not mechanically performed by any production path (spec items 1/2: '自动履行六项取证义务', '引擎侧机械履行', '别只交模块'). decision_mcp.py:_deliver_dd only calls gate_evidence_payload (decision_mcp.py:471), which checks that six keys are truthy in an evidence dict and hashes them — it never runs acceptance_equality / diff_in_scope / zero_test_deletion / rerun_acceptance / mutation_gun / regression_verdict, which remain 'exported but never invoked' outside selfgate.py and tests. No goal-line orchestration wakes on dd_awaiting_gate and performs the obligations, so '线自判路径成引擎默认' is undelivered and a trivially-forged six-key dict satisfies the gate instead of mechanically-gathered evidence.

The spec-required positive-path test '阳性路径（自判 APPROVE → merge 后收割触发）' (items 1/5) is neither implemented nor present in tests/test_m3_line_selfgate.py. Item 5's harvest trigger is only asserted in the fleet-state read-model (stage == 'merger'); no production wiring exercises a self-gate APPROVE flowing into the merge stage and onward to the harvestable view.

Obligation 4 (亲跑验收 / rerun_acceptance) is neither wired into the engine nor tested; the six-obligation '逐项' coverage is incomplete (only obligations 1,2,3,5,6 have direct unit tests), so one of the six mandatory answer fields has no engine path and no red test. Additionally the S9 four款 are only partially exercised (regression_verdict covers red-set growth/green->red/flake attribution but not '缺基线字段拒' nor 'gate 时 main 已漂移仍按冻结 target_base 比对').
